title: Self-promotion channel launched
summary: A dedicated self-promotion space opened for Minecraft creators to share their work safely.
description: The new self-promotion channel gave creators a place to share videos, farms and builds while introducing rules designed to prevent scams and unsafe links.

body.text: Minecraft creators can share content from established platforms and show their farms, builds and other Minecraft projects.
Suspicious links, scams and inappropriate content are not allowed in the channel.
